description: Hands up to 100 boats over to Boatopoly, each an object in the format of get_import_guide. Returns a link for the seller: signed in to Boatopoly, the seller checks every boat in a preview and creates drafts from them. Nothing is published and no account is touched by this call. The link is valid for 3 days.

boats.description: The boats, one object each, with the fields of get_import_guide (boat_type, category, title, manufacturer, model, price, …).

language.description: The language of the conversation with the seller: German (de), English (en), Spanish (es), Czech (cs), French (fr), Italian (it), Dutch (nl), Polish (pl), Croatian (hr), Slovenian (sl), Latvian (lv), Swedish (sv) or Portuguese (pt) (default English). The answers and the links to Boatopoly come in this language.

name: submit_boats

expires_at.description: End of validity of the link (ISO 8601).

title: Hand boats over to Boatopoly
